_scope: Steady-state view of a fleet of four infrastructure Blocks built today and kept on gas at sites of at least 300 mcf/d, hosting customer-owned miners at the US median hosting rate. Block = new continuous-rated Cat G3412-class field-gas genset (423 ekW continuous, 480 V) with oxidation catalyst, Block gas train (scrubber, regulator, meter), 12 Fog C6 immersion tanks with dry coolers plus 35% extra dry-cooler capacity, trailer, Starlink; one leased fuel-gas conditioning skid and H2S scavenger per active site. 248 kW IT per Block (68 S21 XP-class slots). Prices as of Nov 2026. This is the 'if built now' case the study rejects; research/fleet_model.py holds the month-by-month decline, relocation and halving simulation and every scenario in study.md section 9.

gas_mcfd.note: Owner minimum; equals Crusoe's per-module minimum. Contracted volume; evaluator charges fuel on all 300.

gas_btu_per_scf.note: Texas wellhead median, a conservative fuel-energy basis. Raw Permian associated gas can be ~1,500 Btu/scf (gas-pioneer-composition), which is MORE fuel energy; on rich gas the engine's derated capacity becomes the limit (study.md section 5). Site gas chromatograph replaces this value before any purchase.

heat_rate_btu_per_kwh.note: Measured-fuel figure for a Permian/Eagle Ford rental 350 kW field-gas set (120 m3/h at full load). Used as the base because a 423 kW engine at ~64% load on conditioned field gas will not reach a new engine's catalogue peak (~10,060 HHV for G3406 class, pwr-cat-g3406-eff).

parasitic_fraction.note: Dry-cooler fans ~3.2% of load (wtr-cryptocooling-1mw) + immersion pumps + genset radiator/aux + 480 V cable losses.

claimed_it_mw.note: 4 Blocks x 68 slots x 3.645 kW = 991 kW; fuel energy supports 1.014 MW net. Each Block burns 73 mcf/d, so four fit a 300 mcf/d well. Engine: 269 kW gross per Block on a 423 ekW continuous G3412-class engine (eng-g3412-cont), 36% headroom for methane-number derate (eng-pioneer-raw, gas-pioneer-derate).

uptime_fraction.note: 0.92 mechanical/operator availability x (1 - 3 idle weeks per move x 1.8 moves per year / 4 Blocks / 52). The 1.8 moves per year is the simulated 5-year average for wells declining 55%/30%/20%/16.7% (gas-jpt-decline): 9 moves and 5 new sites in 5 years.

gas_cost_usd_per_mcf.note: Off-grid gas miners now typically pay about $1/Mcf. Crusoe paid a 'de minimis' price (com-crusoe-deminimis). No evidence found of Texas operators paying providers to take flare gas.

capex_usd.note: 4 x $406,400 infrastructure Block + $60,000 site-level (gas chromatograph/H2S test, pad, PI-7 registration, fencing, first mobilization). Miners are customer-owned.

opex_ex_fuel_usd_per_year.note: Genset O&M $20/MWh x 8,460 MWh generated = $169.2k; leased conditioning skids ~2.5 active sites x $2k/month = $60k (eng-croft-jt-lease) + H2S scavenger $15k; field tech $60k; security monitoring $12k; Starlink $1k; insurance 2.5% of capex $42.1k (rsk-hotaling-premium 1.5-4%); business personal property tax 1.8% on value above the $125k exemption $28.1k (rsk-bpp-125k); relocations 1.8/yr x $30k = $54k; next-site development $40k/yr.

revenue_usd_per_year.note: US median published hosting rate $0.0725/kWh x 7,783 IT MWh. EZ Blockchain's flare-gas page publishes up to $0.085 all-in (com-ez-hosting-packages), which raises cash by ~$97k/yr; a wellsite Block at ~0.90 availability is unlikely to command more than the grid-site median.

module_count.note: Block sized to ~1/4 of the 300 mcf/d floor (73 mcf/d each) so Blocks leave a declining well one at a time.

module_capex_usd.note: New continuous-rated G3412-class genset $250,000 (estimate within eng-generac-price; Cat does not publish price) + $15,000 freight/commissioning + $10,000 oxidation catalyst (eng-colo-oxcat); 12 Fog C6 at $4,450 incl. dry cooler, PDU, coolant (cmp-fog-c6-price) = $53,400; +35% dry-cooler capacity $13,000 (wtr-bullminers-capex); 480 V distribution $20,000; Block gas train $25,000; trailer/skid $15,000; Starlink, switch, cameras $5,000. With 68 owned S21 XP ($232,560) the Block is $638,960; with a $66,270 import genset instead it is ~$223k (eng-gensetplus-cn, rating class unproven).
